description: Painting a village's ground by surface (core src/editor/layout/ground-plan.ts; the Unreal plugin's BYOA B5 / B7 r5 paint, characterised from its Portable code). A binding's groundLayers read in surface order; the rules for a layered material (authored, else by the layer's name); each surface's coverage at a point (strips and lots feathered, the slope from the terrain, the open ground's patches and flecks by a fixed integer-hashed noise); each layer's 0..255 weight; and the clumping the plugin's own plants take from the same noise. Brightwater Vale's plan and terrain with the B8 pairing's MI_Landscape_01a layers and ground paint; layer names are the pack's words, nothing else of it.
